title: Preserve unknown payload elements
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 3.2.7 Health Certificate Claim. HCERT Specification, 3.2.7 Health Certificate Claim: “Decoding applications SHOULD however be permissive and robust in these aspects”.

statements.label: Preserve unknown payload elements
statements.requirement: Decoding a typed payload SHALL keep unknown elements and SHALL NOT fail because of them, so that newer template versions (v) can still be read and displayed.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-PAY-008 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-PAY-008 unknown payload elements are kept` (AssemblePayloadTest.kt)).
